description: Before you say hello, Agent-Assist has read across the customer's hosting, billing, domain, DNS, and CRM records and pre-diagnosed why the site is down — so you open with the answer, not a lookup.
One consolidated root cause drawn from five systems at once — control panel, billing, customer profile, DNS and email, and the SOP — instead of alt-tabbing across each while the customer waits.
Agent-Assist hands you a plain-language script and flags the jargon that historically lengthens contacts, so you resolve in one call more often.
It surfaces the PCI identity-verification prompt at the right step in the flow — not skipped, not late — and records that verification was completed, protecting compliance.
It forecasts the full-fix path versus deferring to the customer — restoration time, first-contact-resolution, churn and review risk — so you lead with the durable resolution.
It executes the fix with a full audit trail — card, billing email, renewal with loyalty credit, suspension lift, auto-renew — and logs exactly what the AI did versus what you decided.
